rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for things that are identical or alike.

example.english: These two cups of coffee taste the same.
example.traditional: 呢兩杯咖啡飲落一樣㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 bui1 gaa3 fe1 jam2 lok6 jat1 joeng6 gaa3

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal or written attributive expressions to stress that two things are one and the same.

example.english: These two reports are actually the same version.
example.traditional: 呢兩份報告其實係同一個版本。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 fan6 bou3 gou3 kei4 sat6 hai6 tung4 jat1 go3 baan2 bun2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something in the same way or to the same extent, including “love them all the same.”

example.english: I love my two sons the same.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 loeng5 go3 zai2 jat1 joeng6 gam3 sek3

rows.note: Use this when something continues unchanged or is done just as before, rather than emphasizing equal extent.

example.english: It had been raining for so long, but they still went out running the same way.
example.traditional: 落咗咁耐雨，佢照樣出去跑步。
example.jyutping: lok6 zo2 gam3 noi6 jyu5 keoi5 ziu3 joeng6 ceot1 heoi3 paau2 bou6

rows.note: For saying that people or things are the same, this is the all-purpose spoken choice; it is predicative rather than a standalone noun phrase.

example.english: These two coffees taste the same.
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 bui1 gaa3 fe1 mei6 dou6 jat1 joeng6

rows.note: Use this for the exact identical person or thing, especially when a classifier and noun are stated.

example.english: We are wearing the same shirt.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoek6 gan2 tung4 jat1 gin6 saam1

rows.note: Use this noun phrase when “the same” means the same thing or a thing of the same kind.

example.english: I want to buy the same thing again.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 faan1 jat1 joeng6 ge3 je5

rows.note: Use this in expressions meaning that the same applies or that something can likewise be said or done.

example.english: You can go, and I can do the same.
example.traditional: 你可以去，我同樣可以去。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 heoi3 ngo5 tung4 joeng6 ho2 ji5 heoi3
